title: Yaarai Kettu - an original by Priya Foxie | Anal Akash #YKIKV #yaaraikettu
description:
"Art shouldn't just survive, Art should live
Let the art live"

“Yaarai kettu indha kadhal vandhadhu?” 
Love just happened.
It didn’t ask permission.
It didn’t warn her.
It simply arrived.

A story of silent love.
She never planned to fall for him. It just happened — sudden, soft, undeniable.
She keeps her feelings hidden, locked inside her heart.

But somewhere in between stolen glances and quiet moments,
he feels it too.
And yet, he hides it just like her.

Two hearts.
One unspoken love.
No confessions.
Just eyes that say everything.
